## Welcome {-}

This document describes the [Databrary.org](https://databrary.org) data library and how to use it effectively as a tool for safely and securely sharing identifiable research data including video and audio.

Databrary is used by a large and growing community of researchers across the globe. The widespread use and sharing of video can improve reproducibility and rigor of many different areas of research [@Adolph_KE_Gilmore_RO_Kennedy_JL2017-va; @Gilmore2017-wd].

Databrary's mission is to support data sharing and reuse among researchers in the behavioral, social, educational, developmental, neural, and computer sciences. The platform is dedicated to advancing transparency, reproducibility, and collaboration across the research community. Databrary serves as a community of scientists and a resource for those who use video or audio in their research or teaching.
